chapter.title: OF CONTEMPTS OF THE LAWFUL AUTHORITY OF PUBLIC SERVANTS

heading: Obstructing sale of property offered for sale by authority of public servant.
text: Whoever intentionally obstructs any sale of property offered for sale by the lawful authority of any public servant, as such, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one month, or with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees, or with both.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
